chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan, and Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When you enter the city, perform ritual bath before entering it or when you enter it. Then go to the grave of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).

Then stand and send greetings upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). Then stand by the front pillar from the right side of the grave, near the head of the grave, at the corner of the grave. You are facing the Qiblah, with your left shoulder towards the grave and your right shoulder towards what faces the pulpit, for it is the place of the head of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).

And you should say: I testify that there is no god except Allah, Alone, without partner, and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger. And I testify that you are the Messenger of Allah, and I testify that you are Muhammad ibn Abdullah. And I testify that you have delivered the messages of your Lord, and advised your community, and strove in the way of Allah, and worshipped Allah sincerely until certainty (death) came to you with wisdom and goodly admonition, and you fulfilled that which was upon you from the truth. And you were kind to the believers and harsh upon the disbelievers, so Allah brought you to the highest honor of the station of the honored.

Praise is to Allah who saved us through you from polytheism and misguidance. O Allah, so make Your blessings and the blessings of Your near angels, and Your righteous servants, and Your sent prophets, and the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth, and whoever glorified You, O Lord of the worlds, from the first and the last, upon Muhammad, Your servant and Your Messenger and Your Prophet and Your Trustworthy and Your Confidant and Your Beloved and Your Chosen and Your Special and Your Elite and Your Choice from Your creation.
O Allah, give him the Degree and the Means in Paradise, and raise him to a Praised Station, which the first and the last will envy.

O Allah, indeed You said: 'And if they, when they wronged themselves, had come to you and asked forgiveness of Allah and the Messenger had asked forgiveness for them, they would have found Allah Accepting of repentance, Merciful.' And I have come to Your Prophet, seeking forgiveness, repentant from my sins.
And I turn to Allah through you, my Lord and your Lord, that He may forgive my sins.

And if you have a need, place the grave of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) behind your shoulders, face the Qiblah, raise your hands, and ask for your need, for you are more likely to have it fulfilled, if Allah wills.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended method and supplication for visiting the Prophet's grave in Medina according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the specific etiquette (adab) for visiting the Prophet’s grave, emphasizing ritual purity and the precise orientation of the visitor relative to the head of the grave, a practice rooted in Shia jurisprudential tradition. The supplication highlights the theological concept of tawassul, where the Prophet serves as an intermediary for forgiveness and intercession, culminating in the invocation of his 'Maqam Mahmud' (Praised Station).

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al fazl Bin Shazaan, from Safwan, and Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
When you enter Al-Medina, so wash before you enter it, or where you enter it. Then go to the grave of the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>.

Then you should stand and send greetings upon Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>. Then stand by the front pillar from the right side of the grave near the head of the grave in the corner of the grave, and you are facing the Qiblah, and your left shoulder being to the side of the grave, and your right shoulder from what follows the Pulpit, for it is the place of the head of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and you should be saying, ‘

I testify that there is no god except for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Alone, there being no associates for Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and I testify that Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> is His<sup>azwj</sup> servant and His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, and I testify that you<sup>saww</sup> are Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and I testify that you<sup>saww</sup>, Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> Bin Abdullah<sup>as</sup>, you<sup>saww</sup> have delivered the Message of your<sup>saww</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, and preached to your<sup>saww</sup> community, and struggled in the Way of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and worshipped Allah<sup>azwj</sup> sincerely until conviction (death) came to you<sup>saww</sup> with the Wisdom, and the goodly preaching, and that you<sup>saww</sup> fulfilled that which was upon you<sup>saww</sup> from the Truth; and you<sup>saww</sup> were kind with the Believers and harsh upon the Infidels, therefore Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Delivered with you<sup>saww</sup>, the most superior of the honours placed upon the honourable ones.

The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who saved us through you<sup>saww</sup> from the Polytheism and the straying. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Thus, Make Your<sup>azwj</sup> Blessings and the Blessings of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Angels of Proximity, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> righteous servant, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Prophets<sup>as</sup>, the Mursils, and the inhabitants of the skies and the firmaments, and the ones who Glorify to You<sup>azwj</sup>, O Lord<sup>azwj</sup> of the worlds, from the former ones and the later ones, to be upon Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> (who is) Your<sup>azwj</sup> servant, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, and Your<sup>saww</sup> Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> trustworthy one, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> excellent one, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Beloved, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> special one, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Chosen one, Your<sup>azwj</sup> elite, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Choice from Your<sup>azwj</sup> creatures.
O Allahazwj! Give himsaww the Level and the Means from the Paradise, and Resurrect himsaww on the Praiseworthy Place (Maqaam Mahmoud), envied by the former ones and the later ones.

O Allahazwj! Youazwj Said [4:64] and had they, when they were unjust to themselves, come to you and asked Forgiveness from Allah and the Rasool had (also) asked Forgiveness for them, they would have found Allah Oft-returning (to Mercy), Merciful. And I have come to Yourazwj Prophetsaww, seeking Forgiveness, repentant from my sins,
and I hereby divert by you<sup>saww</sup> towards Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, my Lord<sup>azwj</sup> and your<sup>saww</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, so that He<sup>azwj</sup> would Forgive my sins for me’.

And if there was a need for you, so make the grave of the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> to be behind your shoulders, and face the Qiblah and raise your hands, and ask your need, for you would be more entitled that it be fulfilled, if Allah<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires it’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr and Muhammad ibn Isma‘il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan and ibn abu ‘Umayr from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following:
“Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that when you enter al-Madinah, take a shower before you enter or at that time. Thereafter go to the grave of the Holy Prophet,

O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, stand up and offer Salam to the Messenger of Allah. Then stand up near the pillar, the first one from the right side of the grave near the head of the grave and near the corner of the grave when you are facing al-Qiblah (the direction of Makkah). Keep your left shoulder toward the grave and your right shoulder toward the pulpit, which is the place of the head of the Messenger of Allah,

O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause. Thereafter say, ‘I testify that no one except Allah, who is One and only and has no partners, deserves worship. I testify that Muhammad is His servant and His messenger. I testify that you are the Messenger of Allah. I testify that you are Muhammad ibn ’Abd Allah. I testify that you conveyed and preached the messages of your Lord, gave good advice to your followers, strove hard for the cause of Allah, and worshipped Allah sincerely, until the time of your death, with wisdom and good advice. You fulfilled your duty of conveying the truth. You treated believers with compassion and dealt with the unbelievers by means of strength. Allah thus took you to the excellent position of honor of the honorable ones.

All praise and thanks belong to Allah who saved us through you from paganism and straying. O Allah, grant salawat (favors and compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause) and accept such prayers of angels, of prominent position before You, Your virtuous servant, messenger prophets, inhabitants of heavens and earths and all of those who glorify You. O Lord of the world, accept such prayers of those who lived in the past and those to come into being. Accept such prayers in favor of Muhammad, Your servant, Your messenger, Your prophet, Your trusted one, Your chosen one, Your beloved one, Your selected one, the one very special to You, the purified one, the one who is Your choice from among Your creatures.
“O Allah, grant him high position, the means from paradise, raise him to the praiseworthy position which is coveted by those who lived in the past and those who came later on.

O Allah, You have said, “If they do injustice to themselves and then come to you, then ask forgiveness from Allah for their sins and the messenger also asks forgiveness from Allah for them; they will find Allah forgiving and merciful. ”[4:64]
I have come to Your prophet, begging for forgiveness, repenting for my sins and I through you (the Messenger of Allah) have turned to Allah, my Lord, and your Lord, so He forgives my sins.’

If you have any wishes then keep the grave of the Holy Prophet behind your shoulders, face the direction of Ka’bah, raise your hands and ask for your wishes; you deserve to find your wishes made to come true, if Allah so wills.”
